title: pi-jsonl 1 tool_use_result
description: The result of one tool call as Pi recorded it, the tool_use table's result_raw column: the `message` of the toolResult entry that answers the call. The same shape for every tool; `details` is the tool's own.

content.description: Text and image blocks; the tool_use table's output column is the text

details.description: What the tool recorded beside its content: for edit, the diff it applied

usage.description: Present when the tool ran a model of its own
